name: Frequently Asked Questions — Thomas Cherickal
description: 20 Frequently asked questions on technical writing, developer education, quantum content, infinite revision guarantees, and milestone payment structures.

mainEntity.name: How many revisions till satisfied?

acceptedAnswer.text: Infinite revisions. We work together continuously on every deliverable until you are 100% satisfied with technical accuracy, prose clarity, and code execution.

mainEntity.name: How are the payments handled?

acceptedAnswer.text: Payments are handled by milestones, with every milestone having equal weightage on the final product.

mainEntity.name: Who owns the intellectual property and copyright?

acceptedAnswer.text: You retain 100% full IP ownership and copyright upon completion of every project milestone.

mainEntity.name: How is code execution and quantum circuit accuracy verified?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every code snippet, API request, PyTorch pipeline, and Qiskit quantum circuit is manually executed and verified in isolated virtual environments or simulator/hardware backends before publishing.

mainEntity.name: What is Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) / Country Parity Pricing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Parity pricing provides fair global access: Tier 1 Developed (100% Standard Price), Tier 2 Developing (66% Price / 34% Discount), and Tier 3 Least Developed (33% Price / 67% Discount).

mainEntity.name: Is there a discount for early-stage startups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Pre-Seed and Seed-stage startups receive a prominent 50% discount across all technical content services.

mainEntity.name: What technology stacks and frameworks do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generative AI (PyTorch, vLLM, Ollama, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Claude, Gemini APIs), Quantum Computing (IBM Qiskit, PennyLane, Cirq), and Core Systems (Python, Rust, Go, TypeScript).

mainEntity.name: What is the typical turnaround time for a deliverable?

acceptedAnswer.text: Short technical articles take 3–5 business days; standard deep dives take 5–8 business days; full developer documentation suites take 14–21 business days.

mainEntity.name: Do you sign Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Standard mutual NDAs are executed prior to examining unreleased API endpoints, proprietary SDKs, or pre-launch model architecture documentation.

mainEntity.name: Can you write for both developers and executive leaders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Using the Diátaxis framework, content is structured with quickstarts for engineers, deep dives for researchers, and summaries for executives.

mainEntity.name: In what file formats do you deliver content?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clean Markdown (.md), MDX, Jupyter Notebooks (.ipynb), executable Python/Qiskit scripts, OpenAPI/Swagger JSON specs, and direct GitHub Pull Requests.

mainEntity.name: How does AI acceleration work with 100% human verification?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI tools accelerate initial research aggregation and outline drafting. Every line of prose and code is hand-written, tested, and line-by-line verified by Thomas Cherickal.

mainEntity.name: What is included in Remote Engineering Team Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: 2-hour interactive enablement workshops covering Generative AI architecture, local LLM inference deployment, and Post-Quantum Cryptography transition risks.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer monthly content partner retainers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Monthly retainer partnerships provide dedicated sprint capacity for technical articles, changelogs, SDK update guides, and continuous documentation maintenance.

mainEntity.name: What happens if an API version changes shortly after delivery?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor code snippet updates and API breaking change patches are included free for 60 days post-launch under our infinite revision policy.

mainEntity.name: How do we get started on a project brief?

acceptedAnswer.text: Submit your requirements via the brief form on services.html#contact. We return a clear milestone scope proposal within 24 hours.

mainEntity.name: Can you author reproducible benchmark comparison reports?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Standalone benchmarking passes include a dedicated GitHub repository with reproducible scripts for throughput, latency, and accuracy metrics.

mainEntity.name: How are quantum algorithms verified on hardware?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quantum circuits are validated first on statevector simulators, followed by noisy simulation models and execution on IBM Quantum hardware backend channels.

mainEntity.name: Do you support multi-language documentation translation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primary content is authored in clear US English, structured semantically with clean Markdown for seamless translation via automated i18n pipelines.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods do you accept internationally?

acceptedAnswer.text: We accept International Wire Transfer (SWIFT/ACH), Stripe invoices, Wise, PayPal, and major Stablecoins (USDC/USDT).
